history.content: Drain unblocking, mostly for restaurants in Paris.

Done. We will reach owners and managers of independent restaurants in Paris: Le Petit Zinc, Chez Paulette and Bistrot Lune are in the sample. Here is the email Marie at Le Petit Zinc would get:

Subject: Blocked kitchen drain at Le Petit Zinc?

Hi Marie, when a kitchen drain blocks in the middle of service, every minute costs covers. Dutrou unblocks restaurant drains in Paris the same day. Worth keeping our number for the next time?

Shall I go on to the launch?
